landing.title: Plan the day, keep the habits, reach the goals
landing.subtitle: LifeOS is a personal life management system: one place for the daily schedule, habit streaks, goals and the numbers that show what is actually working.

modules.tasks: Plan the day hour by hour and tick tasks off as they happen.
modules.habits: Track streaks on a month grid and see which habits hold up.
modules.goals: Break a goal into subtasks and watch the progress bar move.
modules.analytics: Completion rate, productive hours and a habit overview on one screen.

landing.privacyNote: Google sign-in only — everything stays under your own account.
